task.description: Implement Letflow.Entities.Record.Validator (build_record_schema/1, validate_record_payload/2) exactly per the validated REQ-227 design artefact: reuse Letflow.EventStore.Registry.JsonSchema (cross-namespace alias, no extraction) and Letflow.EventStore.Registry.ValidationFailure verbatim; no route/controller/event registration. Write comprehensive ExUnit tests covering all 7 acceptance criteria.

result.note: New module lib/letflow/entities/record/validator.ex implements build_record_schema/1 and validate_record_payload/2 exactly per the design: build_record_schema/1 maps the 8 field_def() types to JSON-Schema types per design §4.1 (string/integer/decimal->number/boolean/date->string/datetime->string/enum->string+enum/json->omit type), never emits minimum/maximum/maxLength (confirmed against lib/letflow/entities/definition.ex -- field_def() has no length/range attribute to translate), and validate_record_payload/2 delegates entirely to Letflow.EventStore.Registry.JsonSchema.validate/2 (aliased directly, cross-namespace, no extraction, per design §5.1 decision (a)) reusing Letflow.EventStore.Registry.ValidationFailure verbatim. No route, controller, or event registration added. `mix compile --warnings-as-errors`: clean, 'Generated letflow app', zero warnings. `mix format --check-formatted`: failed once on the initial write (one long `required` line), fixed with `mix format`, re-check then produced no output (clean). `mix test test/letflow/entities/record/validator_test.exs`: 'Finished in 0.05 seconds ... Result: 10 passed', 0 failures -- covers AC1 (conforming payload -> [], including a minimal-required-only payload and all six :json-accepts-any-shape cases), AC2 (a dedicated fixture violating 4 distinct problems at once -- type, enum, additionalProperties, and a missing required field -- asserts all 4 violations returned, not just the first), AC3 (exact field_path/constraint/actual triples asserted via literal %ValidationFailure{} equality for a type, a required, and an enum violation), AC4 (asserts validate_record_payload/2's output is byte-identical to calling JsonSchema.validate/2 directly on the schema build_record_schema/1 produced, plus a literal-map assertion on build_record_schema/1's own output and the design doc's own §4.2 worked example reproduced verbatim as a test). AC5/AC6 (namespace-choice and no-route/no-controller) are structural, confirmed via `git status --short`/`git diff --stat`: only two new files exist, lib/letflow/entities/record/validator.ex and test/letflow/entities/record/validator_test.exs -- no router.ex, controller, or migration touched, and no second JSON-Schema-shaped engine file added. AC7 (mix test/mix compile) satisfied by the above. Regression checks: `mix test test/letflow/entities/`: 'Finished in 0.1 seconds ... Result: 47 passed', 0 failures (REQ-225's Definition/Validator/Shape tests unaffected). `mix test test/letflow/event_store/`: 'Finished in 55.3 seconds ... Result: 150 passed', 0 failures (JsonSchema/ValidationFailure/Registry untouched and unaffected). No discrepancy found between the validated design and REQ-225's actual code -- the design's finding that field_def() carries no length/range constraint to translate into minimum/maximum/maxLength was verified directly against lib/letflow/entities/definition.ex and holds exactly as documented; no design-vs-implementation gap analogous to the REQ-226 precedent was found.
